label: Leafy Factory
summary: EV battery module plant. Enterprise root of the Leafy Factory unified namespace.

label: EV Module Assembly
summary: Leafy Factory module assembly line that builds 4-cell EV battery modules and long-range packs.

attributes.mes_name: Leafy Factory | Module Assembly | EV Line

label: 01 Cell Preprocessing
summary: Qualify every incoming cell and prepare its tabs before module assembly.

label: 02 Module Assembly
summary: Build the cell stack and locate it in the mechanical module fixture.

label: 03 High Precision Welding
summary: Create low-resistance electrical joints and watch the process for quality and maintenance signals.

label: 04 Thermal and Encapsulation
summary: Add the thermal path, close the enclosure, and prove the pack is leak-tight.

label: 05 Final Inspection
summary: Validate electrical performance and release a traceable production unit.

label: Cell Screening
summary: Measures open-circuit voltage and internal resistance, then grades every incoming cell.

edges.label: Graded cells move to tab prep

label: Tab Processing
summary: Trims, cleans, and checks cell tabs so every downstream joint starts from consistent material.

label: Z-Fold Stacking
summary: Builds the four-cell stack and records layer count, height, and alignment.

label: Module Pre-Assembly
summary: Positions the cell stack in the module structure and applies controlled clamp force.

label: Laser Tab Welding
summary: Joins copper and aluminum cell tabs. One machine, shopfloor id LTW-04. Predictive maintenance still files its readings under the legacy asset id M1.

edges.label: Welded tabs move to busbar joining

label: Ultrasonic Busbar Welding
summary: Connects busbars with ultrasonic energy and checks weld duration and joint quality.

edges.label: Electrically complete module enters thermal assembly

label: Weld Monitoring
summary: Observes housing temperature and gantry vibration so abnormal weld conditions become maintenance alerts.

label: Cooling Plate Assembly
summary: Dispenses thermal interface material and aligns the cooling plate.

label: Pouch Sealing
summary: Seals the pack under controlled temperature and pressure before leak testing.

label: Helium Leak Test
summary: Checks enclosure integrity and records leak rate against the pass limit.

label: Pack EOL Test
summary: Final voltage, current, resistance, and insulation checks before the unit is released.

label: Tab Laser Welding Cell
summary: The laser tab welder on the module line. Shopfloor id LTW-04. Predictive maintenance telemetry, alerts, and work orders still use the legacy asset id M1.

label: Protective Optics
summary: Cover glass and weld-head optics. Spatter on this window is the usual cause of a fast thermal rise.

label: Focusing Lens
summary: 200 mm fused-silica lens cartridge. Inspected with the cover glass whenever E12 trips.

label: Chiller Coolant Loop
summary: Laser-head chiller, inline filter, and flexible return tubing that can kink during gantry moves.

label: Gantry Linear Stage
summary: High-speed welding gantry rails and carriage bearings. Healthy high-speed motion sits near 24 mm/s.

label: Clamping Fixture
summary: Module fixture and mounting bolts. Torque is rechecked after every EV-PM-4C-S tooling swap.

label: Argon Purge Loop
summary: Shield-gas and optical-housing purge. Nominal flow is 14 to 18 L/min of argon.

label: Housing IR Probe
summary: Infrared probe on the welder weld-head housing. Alerts above 80 C.

label: Gantry Accelerometer
summary: Accelerometer on the Gantry. Alerts above 50 mm/s.

label: LTW-04 Weld-Zone Pyrometer
summary: Weld-zone pyrometer on LTW-04. The 08:14 excursion peaked at 235.2 C against a 230 C copper limit.

label: LTW-04 Argon Flow Meter
summary: Shield-gas flow meter on argon loop 2. Nominal flow sits near 14.5 L/min.

label: E12 High Housing Temperature
summary: Housing temperature exceeded 80 C. The usual path is optics spatter, then coolant restriction, then a leaking purge seal.

label: E13 High Vibration
summary: Gantry vibration exceeded 50 mm/s. Separate fixture torque, bearing wear, and sensor drift before replacing hardware.

label: W-TEMP-01 Weld Zone Over Temp
summary: Edge alarm at 08:14:12 Z on LTW-04. The reading carries no order id; the order is joined later by time window.

label: W-PLUME-01 Weld Plume
summary: Plume alarm on the weld head 29 seconds after the 08:14 thermal peak. Points at contaminated optics.

edges.label: Plume from spatter on the cover glass

label: W-GAS-02 Shield Gas Deviation
summary: Argon loop 2 flow left the recipe window. Also the alarm that fires in the post-shift gap with no running order.

edges.label: Purge seal or gas loop leak

label: W-LASER-02 Laser Power Deviation
summary: Fiber laser 4 left the 500 to 650 W operating window. Often follows optics contamination rather than a laser fault.

edges.label: Delivered power drops through a dirty window

label: W-CLAMP-03 Clamp Deviation
summary: Clamp unit B force left the recipe window. Same fixture path as an M1 E13 after a tooling swap.

label: Optics Spatter Contamination
summary: Weld spatter on the protective window absorbs 1070 nm energy, heats the head, and throws a plume. The fleet excursion signature points here.

edges.label: Lens is inspected with the window

label: Coolant Flow Restriction
summary: Kinked chiller return tubing or a clogged 5-micron filter. Shows up as repeated E12 alerts while the optics look clean.

edges.label: Flow check before parts are issued
Coolant checks in the E12 section

label: Housing Seal Degradation
summary: A degraded Viton seal lets shop air into the optical housing and both temperature and shield-gas alarms follow.

label: Fixture Misalignment
summary: Loose or uneven clamp bolts after a module tooling swap. Contestable candidate: misalignment.

label: Linear Stage Bearing Wear
summary: Carriage bearing wear or rail debris. Vibration trends up from the 24 mm/s baseline. Contestable candidate: bearing degradation.

label: Sensor Calibration Drift
summary: Accelerometer stud, cable shield, or IR probe offset after a sensor swap. Contestable candidate: sensor fault.

label: Protective Optics Window
summary: Fused-silica AR-coated cover glass, 30 mm by 5 mm, for the 1070 nm welding head.

label: Focusing Lens Assembly
summary: 200 mm focal-length fused-silica lens cartridge for the tab laser welding cell.

label: Coolant Filter and Tubing
summary: 5-micron chiller filter with 3 m reinforced PTFE coolant hose.

label: Linear Stage Bearings
summary: Precision linear-rail carriage bearing block for the welding gantry.

label: Clamping Fixture Bolts
summary: M10 by 40 mm high-tensile fixture bolts, pack of 10.

label: Optical Housing Seals
summary: Viton O-ring and argon purge seal kit for the laser welding head.

label: Manual: Operating Parameters
summary: Housing 55 to 75 C, vibration 15 to 40 mm/s, laser 500 to 650 W, argon 14 to 18 L/min.

label: Manual: E12 Troubleshooting
summary: High-temperature checks: optics window, coolant lines, housing seals, and purge flow.

attributes.section: Common Faults and Troubleshooting – E12: High Temperature

label: Manual: E13 Troubleshooting
summary: High-vibration checks: fixture torque, linear stage bearings, and accelerometer calibration.

attributes.section: Common Faults and Troubleshooting – E13: High Vibration

label: Manual: Maintenance Schedule
summary: Weekly optics and coolant checks, monthly fixture alignment, bi-monthly bearings and seals.

label: Mechanical Maintenance
summary: Fixture, gantry, chiller, and bearing work. Matched to maintenance staff skill tags.

label: Welding
summary: Laser optics, purge rebuilds, and tooling changeover on the tab welder.

label: Diagnostics
summary: Separate a true process fault from a sensor or fixture false path before parts are consumed.

label: Electrical Maintenance
summary: Sensor mounting, cable shielding, and instrument replacement.

label: Calibration
summary: Reference vibrometer, IR probe, and focal-offset checks after a repair or tooling swap.

label: Safety Compliance
summary: Inert-gas handling and optical-housing leak checks.

label: EV-PM-4C-S Series Module
summary: Four-cell series module. Copper tab recipe RCP-LTW04-CU-3.2, laser 1380 to 1500 W.

label: EV-PM-4C-P Parallel Module
summary: Four-cell parallel module. Aluminum tab recipe RCP-LTW04-AL-2.8.

label: EV-PK-8M-LR Long-Range Pack
summary: Eight-module long-range pack joined with bimetal Al-Cu busbar strip.

label: MAT-CU-020 Copper Tab Foil
summary: Nickel-plated C11000 copper tab foil, 0.20 mm, from Aurubis. Weld-zone limit 230 C.

label: MAT-AL-030 Aluminum Tab
summary: AA1050 aluminum cathode tab, 0.30 mm, from Hydro. Weld-zone limit 215 C.

label: MAT-CU-025 Busbar Strip
summary: Bimetal aluminum-copper clad busbar strip, 0.25 mm, from Wieland. Weld-zone limit 245 C.

label: SOP-LTW-014 Laser Tab Welding
summary: Controlled laser tab welding procedure. Approved v3.2 is the citable revision; v2.1 is superseded and v4.0-rc1 is still draft.

label: SOP-QMS-008 Out-of-Envelope
summary: Quality procedure for parameter changes outside the proven acceptable range, including the Part 11 signature path.

label: CP-EV-WELD-004 Control Plan
summary: EV welding control plan for station 05 laser tab welding, revision 5.1.

label: POL-OTSEC-003 OT Security
summary: OT write-segmentation policy. Blocks unverified cloud scripts from writing the PLC or the record.

label: Cell Screening Cell
summary: Measures open-circuit voltage and internal resistance, then grades each incoming cell.

label: Tab Processing Cell
summary: Trims and cleans cell tabs before they enter the stack.

label: Z-Fold Stacking Cell
summary: Builds the four-cell stack and checks alignment and height.

label: Module Assembly Cell
summary: Fixtures the stack and applies the clamp force for welding.

label: Ultrasonic Busbar Cell
summary: Joins the busbars and checks weld energy and duration.

label: Weld Monitoring Cell
summary: Watches weld temperature and vibration for the tab welding station.

label: Cooling Plate Cell
summary: Dispenses thermal interface material and fits the cooling plate.

label: Pouch Sealing Cell
summary: Seals the pack under controlled temperature and pressure.

label: Helium Leak Test Cell
summary: Checks enclosure leak rate against the pass limit.

label: Pack EOL Test Cell
summary: Runs final voltage, insulation, and release checks.
